items.title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
items.summary: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

items.title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
items.summary: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

items.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
items.summary: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

items.title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
items.summary: Twice now, crypto firms have found themselves on the side of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission in holding that perpetual futures aren't swaps.

items.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
items.summary: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and st

items.title: Will stablecoins survive once the banks catch up?
items.summary: As crypto firms and banks converge, it is fair to ask what lasting advantage stablecoins have, argues Alessandro Hatami, founder of Pacemakers and former COO of Digital Banking at Lloyds Banking Group.

items.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
items.summary: A December rate hike appears completely assured, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

items.title: Ripple Prime head Marc Asch to step down, Noel Kimmel named successor
items.summary: Asch is stepping down as head of the institutional prime brokerage.

items.title: Bitcoin breaks with stocks, declines as ETF outflows mount, MARA reduces holdings
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 10, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin lags stock rebound in advance of U.S. inflation report
items.summary: Bitcoin slipped despite a Monday rebound in U.S. stocks, with spot ETFs losing $201 million as traders await October inflation data later today.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
items.summary: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.

items.title: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain
items.summary: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.

items.title: Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip
items.summary: The Minnesota lawmaker, who helped establish the Congressional Crypto Caucus, will stay on as Republican whip after Democrats won the midterms.

items.title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
items.summary: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.

items.title: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
items.summary: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.

items.title: Global banks commit $270M to stablecoin venture targeting 2027 launch
items.summary: Project Faro, backed by Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and BBVA, has secured $270 million in funding to launch a US dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027.

items.title: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
items.summary: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.

items.title: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
items.summary: The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform.

items.title: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
items.summary: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.

items.title: Bitcoin Miner HIVE Eyes $45 Million in Annual Revenue From AI Deal
items.summary: The Bitcoin miner says its Boden facility could generate $45 million annually, but a June letter of intent remains nonbinding as executives negotiate financing and customer protections for the project.

items.title: Trump Media Posts $410 Million Profit. Bitcoin Gains Did the Heavy Lifting
items.summary: Truth Social’s parent booked $409.7 million in quarterly income largely from crypto investments, even as its stock remained more than 94% below its March 2024 peak.

items.title: Nvidia Erases 2026 Gains as Republicans Threaten Jensen Huang With Subpoena
items.summary: The chipmaker has erased its 2026 gains as a suspected Chinese espionage case brings fresh scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Near AI Breach Exposes User Details and Data From 18 AI Agents
items.summary: An SGLang flaw let an attacker reach internal systems and potentially view confidential AI requests, exposing the limits of hardware-backed privacy protections.

items.title: Elon Musk Calls Claude Opus 5.5 a 'Masterpiece', Admits Grok 4.8 Won't Match It
items.summary: Elon Musk says the incoming Grok 4.8 will trail Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5, praising his rival’s model while predicting Grok 5 could surpass it in two or three months.

items.title: Grayscale Bets $1 Million on Zcash as Privacy Coin Tumbles
items.summary: Grayscale plans to direct $1 million from its Zcash ETF fees to ecosystem nonprofits and launched a national ad campaign, as ZEC fell more than 11%.

items.title: Goldman, Citi and Global Banks Commit $270 Million to Challenge Crypto’s Stablecoin Giants
items.summary: The funding, backing a U.S.-incorporated issuer codenamed “Project Faro,” covers five years of operations as traditional lenders move to challenge crypto-native giants Tether and Circle.

items.title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot US Inflation Fuels Fears of Bigger Fed Rate Hike
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $74,000 after October inflation beat forecasts, increasing pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise rates again at its December meeting.

items.title: Solana's Jupiter Expands Beyond Trading With Token Baskets, Yield Vaults and New Portfolio
items.summary: The trading platform, which says it has routed more than $1.3 trillion in trades, is launching four products ahead of Solana Breakpoint.

items.title: Decrypt Money Account Gets Confidential Transfers With Solana Privacy Firm Helius
items.summary: Helius' Solana Privacy Rings will let Decrypt users send funds without broadcasting amounts, as it grows out The Information Exchange.
